name: Sony VISCA over IP Camera (Template)
author: Control-It Community
subtitle: Standard PTZ Camera Control over TCP/UDP
descriptionText: Universal Sony VISCA over IP and RS-422 camera controller with byte-delimiter framing (0xFF). Supports pan, tilt, zoom, presets, and power control.

setupFields.label: Camera IP Address
setupFields.helpText: Network IP address of your VISCA PTZ camera.

setupFields.label: Camera Address (1-7)
setupFields.helpText: VISCA camera address index (1 is standard for IP).

variables.name: Last Recalled Preset
variables.descriptionText: Index of the most recently recalled camera preset

actions.title: Pan / Tilt Camera
actions.subtitle: Drive PTZ camera direction and speed
actions.descriptionText: Sends VISCA pan/tilt binary drive packets to the camera.

actions.title: Zoom Lens
actions.subtitle: Zoom in, out, or stop
actions.descriptionText: Drives the optical zoom tele/wide motor at variable speed.

actions.title: Recall Preset
actions.subtitle: Move camera to stored position
actions.descriptionText: Recalls a saved PTZ preset position.
